change.description: Add the administrator AI usage operations surface, per-user quota controls, and a dashboard view covering the latest seven natural days with timezone-aware stacked usage totals and missing-usage visibility.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: The admin-only operations surface adds compatible read and same-origin policy endpoints plus UI routes. It does not remove existing routes, alter public response shapes, or add durable state schema changes.

evidence.command: REQ-SKA-018 requires the dashboard to show seven natural days, a consistent timezone, input/cache/output/call metrics, and incomplete usage visibility
The admin API adds an additive dashboard usage read route while retaining the existing protected admin boundary

current.reasoning: The candidate adds the admin AI usage page, user quota operations, shared usage client types, and the dashboard seven-day usage panel. The dashboard endpoint reuses the existing service aggregation and returns only timezone, range, metric, and trend data; no database migration or durable state shape changes are included.

evidence.command: Dashboard renders four AI usage cards, a three-band seven-day stack, an exact-value table, timezone labeling, and missing/estimated counts

scope_drift.description: The change remains within the T5 administrator operations surface, its protected API contract, deterministic Web Demo fixtures, and focused verification; public site behavior, database schema, and provider metering semantics remain out of scope.

The dashboard shows all seven natural-day rows, timezone labeling, additive token dimensions, and missing/estimated status without introducing persistent state changes.
